_readme: Bands we have already invited, so four of us don't message the same band in one afternoon. /ask-a-band.html reads this and warns before a repeat ask. Entries arrive by email when someone taps "I sent it" — add them here to make them visible to everyone.

_fields.channel: shared | sms | whatsapp | email | instagram | copied
_fields.contact: optional — how they were reached, shared with everyone

_contacts: The shared address book below: band name -> email, number or @handle. It fills the contact field on everyone's phone, so nobody hunts for the same address twice. A contact someone typed on their own phone wins over it.
